name: Duplicati Dashboard
description: Backup status board for a Duplicati server — every job with a green/red result dot, live progress while running, and one tap to open the web UI on the PC.

options.label: Duplicati URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25:8200 — the Duplicati web UI address.

options.label: Web UI password
options.help: The Duplicati web interface password. Not needed if a pre-auth token is set below.

options.label: Pre-auth token (optional)
options.help: Used instead of the password when set. Requires Duplicati started with --webservice-pre-auth-tokens=<token>.

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the dashboard polls Duplicati.
